variants.headline: Still in view: colony openly defies its charter
variants.sub: Open defiance of the charter is taking place in {colony}.
variants.body:
The colony is openly defying its charter. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

Working people deserve a voice in arguments about the authority under which they live. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
